chapterInfo.content:
7
Wɔsɛne Haman
1 # Est 5.8; 6.14 Na ɔhene ne Haman baa sɛ wɔne Ɔhemmaa Ester rebɛnom nsa. 2Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Ester da a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu nso apontoɔ no ase sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne w’adesrɛ, Ɔhemmaa Ester, na wɔmma wo, na ɛdeɛn ne w’adeɛ a worehwehwɛ? Ɛduru ahennie no fa mpo a, wɔbɛyɛ. 3Ɛnna Ɔhemmaa Ester buaa sɛ: Ɔhene, sɛ m’anim aba nyam wɔ w’anim, na sɛ ɔhene pɛ a, ma wɔmfa me nkwa nkyɛ me sɛ m’adeɛ a meresrɛ, ne me nkurɔfoɔ deɛ sɛ m’adeɛ a merehwehwɛ, 4na wɔatɔn yɛn, me ne me man, sɛ wɔnsɛe yɛn nkunkum yɛn nnwerɛ yɛn. Na sɛ wɔretontɔn yɛn ayɛ nkoa ne mfenaa a, anka mɛyɛ komm, nanso ɔtamfoɔ no ntumi nhyɛ ɔhene adeɛ a ɛbɛsɛeɛ no ananmu. 5Ɛnna Ɔhene Akas-weros bisaa Ɔhemmaa Ester sɛ: Hwan ne no na ɛhe na ɔwɔ, na wabɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔbɛyɛ saa no? 6Na Ester se: Onipa ɔhohiahiafoɔ ne ɔtamfoɔ no ne saa Haman otirimuɔdenfoɔ yi. Ɛnna nketenkete kutaa Haman ɔhene ne ɔhemmaa no anim.
7Na ɔhene no sɔree n’abufuo no mu firii nsa pono no ho kɔɔ ahemfie turo no mu. Na Haman sɔre gyinaa sɛ ɔrepa Ɔhemmaa Ester ne nkwa ho kyɛw, ɛfiri sɛ na wahunu sɛ ɔhene no abɔ ne ho pɔbɔne. 8Na ɔhene no sane firii ahemfie turo no mu baa nsa pono no ase, na Haman ahwe nnaeɛ a Ester wɔ soɔ no so. Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Ɔrebɛhyɛ ɔhemmaa ne no ada mpo m’anim wɔ me ara me fie ha nso? Asɛm no firii ɔhene anomu ara pɛ, na wɔkataa Haman ani.#7.8 Wɔkataa Haman ani: Ɛwom sɛ wɔatwerɛ no wɔ Hebri no mu sɛ n’anim deɛ, nanso na ɛyɛ ne ti na wɔakata, sɛdeɛ wɔyɛ onipa bi a wɔrekɔkum no wɔ Persia berɛ soɔ no. 9Na Harbona, mpiafoɔ no mu baako, kaa no ɔhene no anim sɛ: Hwɛ, dua a Haman ayɛ ama Mordekai a ɔkaa ɔhene ho asɛmpa no si Haman fie, ne tentene yɛ basafa aduonu nnum. Na ɔhene no se: Monkɔsɛne no wɔ so. 10Na wɔsɛnee Haman dua a wasiesie ama Mordekai no so. Na ɔhene abufuo ano dwoe.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
